---
title: Community / opportunity listings
labels: enhancement, community
---

Provide a section for listing external volunteer or open-source opportunities related to extracurriculars.

Description
- Add a simple model and UI to list community opportunities and tag them by skill or audience.
- Allow admins to curate and students to browse and express interest.

Acceptance criteria
- Opportunities can be added/edited by admins.
- Students can browse and bookmark opportunities.

Notes
- Inspired by `elixirschool/extracurricular` but scoped for school audiences.
